name.zh: Odaraia 开口筒甲游泳动物

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish open-ended tubular carapace, oversized spherical eyes and a three-bladed tail in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以两端开口筒甲、大球眼与三叶尾搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

reconstruction_notes.en: Original living whole-organism interpretation: soft internal trunk and short projecting head enclosed by a naturally tapered tube carapace open at both ends, proportionate large paired eyes, simplified internal paddles and a connected telson with two lateral blades plus one vertical blade. Nominal0.1m tube/body scale, muted palette and static pose are art choices. No closed bivalve capsule, lateral long-spine substitute, reused Dollocaris/Isoxys mesh, exact segment/limb count, fine head-organ or swimming-mechanism claim. Closed semantic roots overlap organically while shell apertures remain actual geometry.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创全体生活复原：柔软内躯与短前伸头部包于自然渐收、两端开口的筒甲中，具比例克制的大型双眼、简化内侧桨肢，以及两侧各一叶和一片竖叶组成的相连三叶尾。0.1米名义筒甲/体尺度、柔和配色及静姿为美术设定。不做封闭双瓣囊甲或长侧刺替代，不复用Dollocaris/Isoxys网格，不主张精确体节/肢数、细小头器官或游泳机制。封闭语义部件在根部自然交叠，筒甲孔口保留真实几何。

claim_scope: Named-taxon-inspired teaching art using basic recognizable form, not strict scientific reconstruction; no exact species/measurement/locomotion/coexistence claim.

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
